basic_profile.bio: Tech-savvy and a huge fan of smart home devices, I've been on Reddit for 5 years sharing tips and engaging in discussions about the latest in entertainment and technology. Living in Annapolis, I'm a software developer by day and a house renovator by night. My partner and I love flipping houses on weekends. I usually browse Reddit late at night after work hours. I dislike buggy tech and am always on the lookout for upgrades.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in software development, I've self-taught myself through various online resources and hands-on projects. I'm particularly knowledgeable about smart home technologies and enjoy keeping up with the latest tech trends.
